entry_state: The annual and quarterly statements form a shared financial history without identifying every transaction. Revenue notes leave gross deferrals and receipts unresolved, while lease and purchase commitments require separate measurement and delivery histories; the payment example continues on the next page.
exit_state: Funding requires restrictions, security turnover and dated collections, with customer overlap preserved. Regional sales and segment earnings do not identify corporate cost allocations or asset ownership; the product-by-region construction now exposes an unobserved joint table.
findings: The purchase example completes the distinction between inventory delivery and payment without asserting actual Apple cash. Liquidity amounts retain restriction, maturity and valuation populations.
Security residuals8263 and−2303 remain unexplained; reported OCI is not substituted. Customer concentrations preserve indivisible membership and overlapping groups, rather than adding18%,11% and33%.

Segment labels retain their issuer-specific geography. The corporate-cost bridge and hypothetical allocations demonstrate that consolidated earnings do not identify fully allocated regional profit. Country assets and regional sales remain separate populations. No new confirmed defect in these pages.
